# genericODE2matrixFormatsTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [genericODE2matrixFormatsTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/genericODE2matrixFormatsTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  ObjectGenericODE2 with its mass, stiffness and damping matrices given dense and sparse, with the
#           dense and the sparse linear solver (#777): a chain of four masses on springs, fixed at one end and
#           pulled at the other, as one GenericODE2 on four 1D coordinates. All four combinations give the same
#           motion, and the static deflection is the one of the springs in series.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-05
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
import numpy as np

testIsActive = exu.sys.get('testIsActive', False)

n = 4
(mass, k, d, force) = (0.5, 1e3, 2., 10.)
M = mass*np.eye(n)
K = np.zeros((n,n))
for i in range(n): #spring i between mass i-1 (or the wall) and mass i
    K[i,i] += k
    if i > 0:
        K[i-1,i-1] += k; K[i-1,i] -= k; K[i,i-1] -= k
D = d/k*K

def Container(matrix, sparse):
    container = exu.MatrixContainer()
    if sparse:
        triplets = [[i, j, matrix[i,j]] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if matrix[i,j] != 0]
        container.SetWithSparseMatrix(np.array(triplets), numberOfRows=n, numberOfColumns=n, useDenseMatrix=False)
    else:
        container.SetWithDenseMatrix(matrix, useDenseMatrix=True)
    return container

def Run(sparseMatrices, linearSolverType, static=False):
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    nodes = [mbs.AddNode(Node1D(referenceCoordinates=[0])) for i in range(n)]
    mbs.AddObject(ObjectGenericODE2(nodeNumbers=nodes, massMatrix=Container(M, sparseMatrices),
                                    stiffnessMatrix=Container(K, sparseMatrices), dampingMatrix=Container(D, sparseMatrices),
                                    forceVector=[0]*(n-1)+[force]))
    mbs.Assemble()
    settings = exu.SimulationSettings()
    settings.linearSolver.solverType = linearSolverType
    settings.solution.file.write = False
    settings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
    settings.staticSolver.verboseMode = 0
    settings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 200
    settings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.5
    if static:
        mbs.SolveStatic(settings)
    else:
        mbs.SolveDynamic(settings)
    return mbs.systemData.GetODE2Coordinates()

results = []
for sparseMatrices in [False, True]:
    for linearSolverType in [exu.LinearSolverType.EXUdense, exu.LinearSolverType.EigenSparse]:
        results.append(Run(sparseMatrices, linearSolverType))
        exu.Print('sparse matrices', sparseMatrices, ',', linearSolverType, ':', results[-1])
difference = max(np.linalg.norm(result - results[0]) for result in results)
static = Run(True, exu.LinearSolverType.EigenSparse, static=True)
staticExpected = force/k*np.arange(1, n+1) #springs in series: each spring carries the force
exu.Print('largest difference of the combinations', difference, ', static', static, ', expected', staticExpected)

u = np.sum(results[0]) + int(difference < 1e-12) + int(np.linalg.norm(static - staticExpected) < 1e-8) #within the Newton tolerance
exu.Print('solution of genericODE2matrixFormatsTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
